title: Domestic Electrician
summary: Residential wiring, safety checks, earthing, testing, and fault isolation for domestic electrical installations.
safety_critical_steps: Isolate/lock out and verify power is off before work.
Check PPE and tool condition before starting work.
Confirm earthing and earth continuity before energising.

rubric.1: Unsafe or incomplete work with poor safety and diagnosis.
rubric.2: Basic task completion with inconsistent safety and quality control.
rubric.3: Competent in routine domestic wiring and safe testing.
rubric.4: Reliable and safe execution with accurate fault identification.
rubric.5: Highly consistent, safe, and professional quality across tasks.

checklist: Conduct a site safety and risk review
Wear PPE and inspect tools before starting
Measure route and decide cable path
Install or fix wiring, conduits, and fittings
Test continuity, insulation, and earthing
Diagnose common faults and re-test after correction
Verify final switchboard and fixture alignment
Record final checks and housekeeping details

nos.title: Plan and prepare work area
nos.description: Assess site, identify hazards, prepare tools and PPE.

nos.title: Install domestic wiring and fixtures
nos.description: Fix cables, conduit, switchboards, and light points.

nos.title: Perform earthing and continuity checks
nos.description: Verify earth continuity, polarity, and circuit integrity.

nos.title: Diagnose basic faults and repair
nos.description: Isolate faults in lighting, sockets, and branches.

nos.title: Complete final inspection and handover
nos.description: Document safe completion and work quality checks.

title: Plumber (General)
summary: Water supply, drainage, fixture installation, pipe fitting, and safe plumbing operations.
safety_critical_steps: Check pressure and isolate supply before cutting or fitting.
Use correct PPE and confirm tool condition.
Verify leak-free joints and pressure testing before closure.

rubric.1: Pipes and joints are not compliant or leak-prone.
rubric.2: Basic fitting attempts are incomplete or uneven.
rubric.3: Routine pipe work is installed with acceptable quality.
rubric.4: Strong pipe routing and dependable joint integrity.
rubric.5: Skilled, neat, and durable plumbing work with safe testing.

checklist: Check water supply and isolate the line
Measure pipe route and select correct fitting
Cut, prepare, and fix piping securely
Join pipe sections with correct sealing method
Install sanitary fittings and valves
Leak test under working pressure
Check final alignment and drainage flow
Document final quality and housekeeping

nos.title: Prepare plumbing work area
nos.description: Inspect pressure, layout, and hygiene conditions.

nos.title: Measure and route piping
nos.description: Plan pipe alignment and fitting locations.

nos.title: Install pipe joints and fittings
nos.description: Fix and seal pipe segments for service integrity.

nos.title: Install sanitary fixtures and valves
nos.description: Mount valves, taps, and sanitary fittings correctly.

nos.title: Test for leaks and completion
nos.description: Conduct pressure checks and final handover.

title: Mason
summary: Block work, plastering, masonry alignment, and finishing for structural and finishing tasks.
safety_critical_steps: Check material quality and safe stacking before work.
Wear PPE and confirm working area is stable.
Verify level and alignment before final finishing.

rubric.1: Work is uneven, unstable, or unsafe.
rubric.2: Fundamental masonry is inconsistent and needs supervision.
rubric.3: Standard block and plaster tasks are completed with acceptable finish.
rubric.4: Strong alignment, stable structure, and neat finishing.
rubric.5: Professional finish, precision, and consistently durable masonry.

checklist: Assess site and ground conditions
Prepare mortar or mix in the correct proportion
Lay first course with accurate line and level
Build masonry wall or blockwork to specification
Check bond pattern and vertical alignment
Apply plaster or finish by surface requirements
Clean joints and remove excess material
Carry out final inspection and documentation

nos.title: Interpret masonry plan and prepare site
nos.description: Review layout, safety, and material requirement.

nos.title: Mix and prepare mortar materials
nos.description: Prepare correct mix and tool readiness.

nos.title: Lay masonry and maintain alignment
nos.description: Build walls and check level and bond.

nos.title: Apply plaster and finish surfaces
nos.description: Prepare and finish plasters and surfaces.

nos.title: Final quality check and handover
nos.description: Inspect output and document workmanship.

title: Tailor / Sewing Machine Operator
summary: Fabric measurement, cutting, machine stitching, finishing, and garment quality inspection.
safety_critical_steps: Confirm machine guard and needle safety before starting.
Check fabric alignment and sharp tool handling.
Verify seam quality and finish before final handover.

rubric.1: Seams and fit are inconsistent and unsafe.
rubric.2: Basic stitching is visible but needs significant correction.
rubric.3: Routine tailoring and machine operation are acceptable.
rubric.4: Good fit, seam consistency, and neat garments.
rubric.5: Professional quality with accurate finishing and strong garment control.

checklist: Check design specification and fabric type
Take measurements and mark pattern accurately
Cut fabric with proper alignment
Set machine and thread to the required stitch
Stitch main seams and finishing details
Check fit, seam strength, and alignment
Press and finish the garment
Inspect final quality and package for handover

nos.title: Interpret garment specification
nos.description: Understand the design, size, and material requirements.

nos.title: Cut and prepare fabric
nos.description: Mark, align, and cut cloth to pattern.

nos.title: Operate machine for stitching
nos.description: Manage machine settings and stitch seams accurately.

nos.title: Finish and press garment
nos.description: Perform hems, edging, and garment finishing.

nos.title: Check quality and final package
nos.description: Inspect final workmanship and present for handover.

title: Domestic Data Entry Operator
summary: Data capture, form entry, validation, file management, and safe digital work practices.
safety_critical_steps: Protect data and verify source document before entry.
Confirm login and workstation safety before use.
Validate output accuracy before final filing or submission.

rubric.1: High error rate and poor file discipline.
rubric.2: Basic entry is slow and inconsistent.
rubric.3: Routine data entry is accurate with moderate speed.
rubric.4: Reliable entry, validation, and file handling.
rubric.5: Very accurate, efficient, and disciplined digital records management.

checklist: Verify source document and task instructions
Open correct form, spreadsheet, or database
Enter data accurately in the right fields
Validate duplicate, missing, or inconsistent entries
Correct errors and update the record log
Save file, backup, and secure the document
Review output quality and completion status
Prepare handover or submission notes

nos.title: Prepare source document and workstation
nos.description: Check forms, files, and machine readiness.

nos.title: Capture and verify data entry
nos.description: Input information accurately and validate fields.

nos.title: Maintain records and file structure
nos.description: Organise digital records and keep naming consistent.

nos.title: Check for errors and corrections
nos.description: Identify and correct mismatches, missing data, or duplicates.

nos.title: Submit final records and document completion
nos.description: Final quality review and secure handover.
